scientific_question: Can the two independently accepted feature-forming procedures coexist: generated QK+V attention and procedural c_fc in all layers, while both attention c_proj and MLP c_proj remain dense residual-stream write maps?

theory.reconciled_observation: Across attention and MLP, compact procedures succeed on Q/K/V and c_fc but fail on attention c_proj and MLP c_proj. The common boundary is not attention versus MLP; it is feature formation versus writing a transformed feature back into the shared residual stream.
theory.candidate_principle: Generate only feature-forming maps and preserve both residual-write projections as dense Muon matrices. This is the smallest joint causal test of the residual-write bottleneck hypothesis and changes no rejected c_proj mechanism.
theory.why_joint_training: The endpoint swap studies showed strong co-adaptation. The two accepted components must therefore train together from initialization; terminal checkpoint transplantation cannot test compatibility.
theory.why_not_another_cproj: The tail-two LWT run failed both its terminal and fixed-curve gates. Fixed random charts, capacity expansion, activation metrics, bilateral/symmetric/volume corrections, optimizer-state transport, paper activation, low-rank residual state, and layer-mask repair are closed at the current compact budget.
theory.claim_boundary: A pass establishes only a residual-write-preserving partial architecture at 124M/5TPP. It is not full attention replacement, full MLP replacement, parameter-count compression, memory reduction, or a larger-rung authorization. The current implementation retains materialized trainable weights and dense optimizer state.

candidate.attention_qkv: exact accepted QK64 plus V16 generated QK+V structure, Cayley subgroup scale 10/3, output gains, and all associated seeds/settings
candidate.attention_cproj: dense Muon; no generated chart, gain, Cayley factor, or adapter
candidate.mlp_cfc: exact accepted directed-product schedule [22,22,22,22,22,22], radius 1.0, ridge 1e-6, chunk 256, error-feedback decay 1.0 in all twelve layers
candidate.mlp_cproj: dense Muon; no procedural chart, modulation, gain, or adapter
candidate.training_gauge: all components initialize and co-adapt in one from-scratch run
candidate.frozen_training: learning rate 2.4e-3, AdamW fallback scale 0.3, Muon momentum 0.95, schedule, batch, data, model seed, data seed, and evaluation windows are unchanged
forbidden_changes: any attention or MLP c_proj replacement
different QK/V or c_fc capacity, connectivity, optimizer, or feedback
learned basis, LoRA, dense residual adapter, HyperConnection, modulation, or Mapping Loss
post-result threshold changes, automatic retry, parallel arm, or larger rung

decision_rule.pass: Accept the residual-write-preserving joint structure as the 124M/5TPP partial Pareto endpoint. Do not call it full replacement and do not scale without a separate plan.
decision_rule.fail: Reject composition of the two accepted feature-forming procedures because their co-adaptation is adverse. Retain the components as separate local controls and launch no variant sweep.

performance_gate.mode: foreground exact scientific config with one warmup and eight timed real updates; direct polling without a watchdog

monitoring.callback_action_prompt: verify terminal identity, fixed losses, both dense residual-write projections, optimizer ownership, MFU, provenance, checkpoint and hashes; compare against the QK+V parent and fair dense control; seal the result and continue the theory plan autonomously
